assets.name: 01-misty-ridges
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: portrait ambient landscape artwork for the left side of a dark personal essay website, one of ten coordinated backgrounds.
Input image: reference image for pixel-art technique and night palette ONLY, not an edit target. Create a completely new scene. Preserve the visual family of refined hand-placed square pixel clusters, layered atmospheric landscape depth, midnight ink/navy, desaturated slate blue, muted forest green. Much SIMPLER and CALMER than reference: broad shapes, large quiet areas, low contrast, minimal tiny detail, no busy dithering, no photographic grain. No figures, people, animals, desks, books, lamps, buildings, text, icons, border, or watermark.
Composition: tall 2:3 portrait image. It will fill a narrow left side column next to a reading pane. All meaningful landscape interest inside leftmost 70%; rightmost 25% remains very simple dark haze. Main subtle silhouette or landform around lower-middle left. Top half is spacious dim sky/haze. Readable as a quiet environment even when cropped into a short mobile banner. Avoid bright sun or moon, stars, dramatic rays, vivid oranges, hard bright highlights. Ambient blue hour, hushed, contemplative. Rich enough to recognize the place but subordinate to article text. Render one full standalone illustration, NOT a contact sheet or website mockup.
Scene/backdrop: Three softly receding rounded mountain ridges in indigo mist. Foreground lower left is a simple dark slope with only a few low grasses. Broad empty blue-grey clouded sky. No sharp dramatic peaks.
